common_mistakes.consequence: The moving bridge may collapse after 0.8 seconds of occupation and the ferry moves away; Isp may fall toward the central slime field.
common_mistakes.recovery: Bridge respawns after 2 seconds; use the small recovery fold to reboard/approach if safely reached. An actual human recovery path was not observed.

confirmed: The two-ferry subtitle, Isp STOP and Pac STEADY cues point toward a role split; the central route includes a temporary bridge and both exits must be reached.
missed_mechanics: Isp STOP hold opens Pac’s island barrier and parks the first ferry; leaving releases it.
Pac’s STEADY hold also stops the second ferry and opens Isp’s bridge gate; stepping clear releases that ferry.
The bridge collapses after 0.8 seconds only when not stabilized, then resets after 2 seconds; Isp’s RESCUE latch stabilizes it permanently and opens Pac’s finish gate.
The active slime fields are below mandatory gaps, and the far recovery fold is a possible reapproach aid.
incorrect_inferences: The first pass’s bridge speculation was partly right, but did not identify the support-based collapse timer or Pac’s ability to remove it.
The visible gaps do imply danger here: authored slime hazards lie below mandatory crossings, unlike the harmless floor impression in some other rooms.
changed_judgments: Reasoning remains 3 because source confirms the ordered stop/steady/board/release/rescue dependency rather than a single simple ferry action.
Cooperation remains 3, now supported by two necessary pad roles and the release-after-boarding / rescue dependency.
Execution decreases from 3 to 2: the ordinary-input route completes the two crossings with zero retries; the route still requires several jumps but there is no evidence of severe precision.
Timing remains 2, now grounded in the 0.8-second unstabilized bridge collapse and the release-after-boarding order; holding STEADY makes the window controllable.
Hazards increases from 2 to 3: two mandatory slime-gap exposures are lethal, with only start/island/finish refuge.
Novelty decreases 3 to 2 because steady/rescue/ferry/splitting lessons were cued earlier; the novel demand is their two-ferry sequence.
Recovery changes from unknown to 2 because the bridge respawns and a recovery fold exists, but slime death resets mandatory setup.
Solution clarity remains 2: visible labels cue the roles, but the detailed ordered dependency appears in source hint rather than room subtitle. Control friction stays unknown.
unresolved: No human attempt, fall, recovery, hint use, time, enjoyment, or difficulty distribution was observed.
The single accepted route proves feasibility with ordinary inputs but does not measure tolerance to missed ferry boarding or timing variability.
The route record captures one of two collectibles; whether both can be acquired on the mandatory line without extra exposure is untested.

single_operator_note: One operator would need to coordinate keys for Isp STOP/release and Pac ferry crossing, then Pac STEADY release against Isp boarding/rescue. The browser route is not a physical shared-keyboard study.
